First release of Media Manager. Install it with [BRAT](https://github.com/TfTHacker/obsidian42-brat) by adding `anupchavan/obsidian-media-manager` as a beta plugin, then enable **Media Manager** in **Settings → Community plugins**. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later with the **Bases** core plugin on.

### Gallery layout for Bases
- A new **Gallery** layout for bases shows each note's photo, video or PDF, read from a property you choose (a wiki link, Markdown link, vault path or web address, or a list of them).
- **Mosaic** interlocks tiles of different sizes in rows and columns with no gaps; **Rows** lays them out in justified rows like Google Photos, cropping at most 10% a side.
- **Size by** makes tiles larger for notes with more links, backlinks and shared tags, or by a property (`small`, `large` or a number). **Smallest tile** keeps small tiles legible.
- Only tiles on screen exist, more load as you scroll, and photo sizes and thumbnails are cached on your device, so large vaults scroll smoothly. HDR photos and videos are detected; **HDR tiles** chooses whether the grid shows them in HDR.

### Viewing
- Click a tile to fill the window, MUBI style. Scroll, click outside or press Esc to close; Cmd-click (Ctrl-click) opens the note.
- Videos preview on hover with a mute button that remembers its setting, and play zoomed with their own controls: play, scrubbing, time, mute, fullscreen and keys (Space or K, ← →, J L, ↑ ↓, M, F).
- PDFs show their first page as a tile with a page count, and open in Obsidian's own PDF viewer.
- The **i** button in the corner of a zoomed item shows the note's properties as a card, and a map when the note has a location and Obsidian Maps is installed.
- Cmd-← and Cmd-→ (Ctrl on Windows and Linux) step to the previous and next item, and photos also take ← and →. **Show previous item** and **Show next item** can be bound to other keys in **Settings → Hotkeys**.

### Images in notes
- Images in your notes open with the same zoom instead of Obsidian's image viewer. Turn this off with **Zoom images in notes**.

### Media notes
- A note whose `url` property links to a photo, video or PDF is a media note. Embedding it (`![[note]]`) gives Obsidian's own media embed in reading view and while editing, with its resize handle, zoom and edit buttons, without the note's title or border.
- **Media notes** in settings takes Bases filters (for example `categories` contains `[[Photos]]`) to limit which notes count. This uses Bases internals that have no public API, the same way Custom Views does, and does nothing if Obsidian changes them.

### Validation
- 54 automated tests pass (layouts, header parsing, relatedness, formatting, local deploy), plus lint (ESLint with the Obsidian plugin rules, Stylelint matching the plugin review's CSS checks) and the production build.
- Checked in Obsidian 1.15.1 desktop: scrolling 1,500 notes (median frame 8.3 ms, no long tasks), plugin startup (0.4 ms), zoom, video and PDF viewing, previous and next, pop-out windows, hidden tabs, sidebar changes, media note embeds in both modes, and no leaks after 40 zooms.
- Release files carry build provenance attestations; see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/anupchavan/obsidian-media-manager/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release) to verify them.
- Mobile was not tested on a device. HEIC photos and Dolby Atmos audio don't play in Obsidian.
